title: incremental parse pipeline
description:
## Parent

sutra/1 — prd for sutra watcher daemon

## What to build

New `parse_changed_files` function in `pipeline.rs` that takes explicit `changed` + `deleted` path lists instead of walking the directory tree. Handles the full incremental pipeline: delete file/symbols/refs for removed files, parse changed files via `parse_single_file`, cascade re-resolution to files referencing deleted symbols, resolve refs for dirty set, recompute rollups with dirty set, full PageRank recomputation.

File renames are treated as delete + create — no special-case logic.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `parse_changed_files(workspace, db, config, changed, deleted)` function exists in `pipeline.rs`
- [ ] Deleted files have their file rows, symbols, and refs removed from DB
- [ ] Files referencing deleted symbols are added to the dirty set and re-resolved
- [ ] Changed files are parsed and refs resolved
- [ ] Rollups (fan-in, blast radius) recomputed for dirty set only
- [ ] PageRank recomputed (full)
- [ ] Unit tests: single file change, file deletion with cascade, multiple files changed

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately."
